scope.calibration: Faster variant targeted to requested duration with a slower-variant duration cap.
scope.compilation: Swift 6, -O -whole-module-optimization; benchmark and production files compiled together.
scope.limits: No whole-player CPU, playback, frame-rate, energy, or UI performance claim.
scope.measurements: Warm synthetic component operations, fresh process for each observation.
scope.pairing: Equal iteration counts; alternating AB/BA pairs; workload order rotated by pair index.
scope.platform: Linux component qualification and paired measurements; not native macOS qualification.
scope.production: Exact FixedRingBuffer.swift and PacketQueue.swift, no source extraction or platform adapters.
scope.slow_samples: No observations discarded; samples exceeding the calibration budget are retained.

shared_queue.contract: Use the exact current PacketQueue.swift for both baseline and candidate; freeze only the ring-buffer baseline.
